entries.observation: The four-node homotopy organigram is clear. Both curved dashed arrows carry their small numeric labels outside the neighboring straight arrows, and no label crosses an object.
The opposed curved arrows between Q and L have distinct r and s labels. The small diagram and surrounding prose fit cleanly.

The r and s labels are clear, but the large outer Q(M) to Hom_3(M) arrow intersects the subscript0 in the middle-left Q_0 object. Enlarged actual inspection is saved in qa/rendered/reading_diagram_0218_detail.png; this is reported for repair.

The prose, conditions and implication diagram fit within the page, but enlarged actual inspection of the diagram reveals Hom_3 intersecting the straight downward arrow beside the bent upward arrow. This collision is reported separately for repair; detail image qa/rendered/reading_diagram_0219_detail.png.
The naturality triangle and its curved comparison arrow have distinct lambda_i and side labels. The upper square and all surrounding formulas are fully visible.
The naturality triangle has a clear curved lambda_i comparison arrow between its two sloping maps. No label crosses an object or neighboring arrow; the remainder of the page fits.

The page’s two implication diagrams and surrounding prose fit inside the body, but the first diagram has a definite collision: the if A,B W-asph. label crosses central node (iv prime). Enlarged inspection is saved in qa/rendered/reading_diagram_0304_detail.png and the defect is reported separately for repair.
The localization triangle has a distinct lambda-bar label and equivalence marker on its comparison arrow. The lower margin correction and surrounding prose remain clear.
The sequence of equivalence formulas and the two curved functor arrows are fully visible. Their labels and central natural-transformation arrow remain distinct, and the lower paragraph fits.
The curved pi_0 arrow beneath the three-object functor chain has its label below the curve, with ample clearance. The upper aligned formulas and lower commuting diagram also fit.
The outer curved u arrow passes wholly left of the middle-left object and its adjacent u_0/alpha labels. The two-square abelianization diagram and its continuation are fully visible.
The upper functor diagram with curved outer arrows and lower exact triangle are complete. Their labels, central objects and arrowheads remain distinct; surrounding formulas fit the body.
The four-functor diagram has clear paired and curved arrows with nonoverlapping labels. The bracketed adjunction conditions and final two-line formula fit cleanly.
